subject.title: fix(discord): use configured statusReactions.timing instead of DEFAULT_TIMING

question: Should this PR land as a documented-behavior fix that makes existing Discord `messages.statusReactions.timing` values affect final reaction hold duration once real Discord proof is supplied?
rationale: The code path is narrow and matches documented/sibling behavior, but automation cannot make the maintainer compatibility call for existing non-default Discord timing configs.

options.title: Accept documented behavior after proof
options.body: Land the narrow fix once a redacted live Discord or completed Mantis artifact shows configured done/error reactions remain until the configured cleanup window.

options.title: Require a compatibility plan
options.body: Ask for an explicit upgrade or release-note plan if maintainers do not want existing non-default timing values to take effect immediately.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Keep the PR open without merge until the owner decides whether Discord timing parity is still the desired behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept documented behavior after proof
recommendation.body: Land the narrow fix once a redacted live Discord or completed Mantis artifact shows configured done/error reactions remain until the configured cleanup window.
